messages:
raj - sales: Hey team, FinBank deal asking for a private deployment POC. They want an air-gapped sandbox + a staged fallback to hosted keys. Quick checklist: GPU driver reqs, CUDA compat, k8s version, nvidia-docker, kernel modules, and any cloud egress controls. Also pricing for a small dedicated pool for the trial. Who can confirm the minimal node image and access flow?

emily - infra: I can take driver/CUDA/k8s compatibility. Short answer: we support NVIDIA drivers >=470, CUDA 11.7+ for our current runtime; for newer Ampere/Blackwell recommend 515+ and CUDA 12 where available. k8s: 1.22–1.26 tested; prefer 1.24 for POC. Need nvidia-container-toolkit + nvidia-docker2.

mark - sre: Also confirm kernel >=5.10 for driver module stability. If customer has RHEL/Centos variants, we usually recommend RHEL8.6 or Ubuntu 22.04 LTS. We'll need ssh access to at least one node for driver install validation (can be ephemeral).

maria - solutions: For the sandbox access flow: we can provision a short-lived hosted API key for fallback (scoped, rate-limited) and a dedicated pool estimate: for small POC (3x A10-equivalent nodes) — estimate monthly reserved: ballpark $Xk/month but I'll sync with pricing. For the POC itself we can do a time-limited discounted commit.

raj - sales: @maria please add the actual numbers; FinBank wants clear cost vs hosted fallback. Also they sent a security questionnaire about network flows and KMS.

nina - security: For VPC/private we support customer-managed KMS + HSM integrations. Audit logs available from the private control plane; we can provide syslog/forwarding to their SIEM. Network: we require outbound access only for control plane registration unless fully air-gapped. For air-gapped install we provide an offline bundle and SHA256 checksums.

raj - sales: Good. Two blocker checks from FinBank: 1) Can we run in fully air-gapped mode with on-prem KMS? 2) Can shared nodes be prevented from routing egress to internet?

emily - infra: 1) Yes, offline bundle + private control plane to be hosted in their VPC or on-prem. 2) We can configure egress rules + host-level iptables to block outbound. For absolute guarantee, run in isolated subnet with no NAT.

mark - sre: Operational note: we need node-level logs and a kubeconfig with RBAC user for our on-call during the POC. We'll propose read-only and a separate service account for the runtime (no cluster-admin).

infra-bot: deployment-check: found nodes: 3 GPU nodes (A10x), kernel: 5.15.0-60, nvidia-driver: 470.161.03, cuda: 11.7 -- drivers OK but recommend driver 515+ for best perf on new models.

maria - solutions: For the security questionnaire answers I'll prepare a one-pager: network diagram (control plane vs data plane), KMS flow, audit retention, SOC2 notes. Also will include recommended node AMI/container image and the `kubeadm` or `eks` notes.

raj - sales: Next steps: @maria send pricing + one-pager; @emily share exact install commands we want them to run and the offline bundle link; @mark draft the RBAC snippet. I'll ask FinBank for SSH to one node and the security contact for KMS fingerprinting.

emily - infra: install snippet (quick):
```
# install nvidia driver
sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y build-essential dkms
sudo bash ./NVIDIA-Linux-x86_64-515.run --silent
# install nvidia-container-toolkit
distribution=$(. /etc/os-release;echo $ID$VERSION_ID)
curl -s -L https://nvidia.github.io/nvidia-docker/gpgkey | sudo apt-key add -
curl -s -L https://nvidia.github.io/nvidia-docker/$distribution/nvidia-docker.list | sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/nvidia-docker.list
sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y nvidia-container-toolkit
sudo systemctl restart docker
```

mark - sre: RBAC snippet (service account + role binding):
```
apiVersion: v1
kind: ServiceAccount
metadata:
  name: redwood-runtime
  namespace: redwood
---
kind: ClusterRole
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
metadata:
  name: redwood-runtime-role
rules:
- apiGroups: [""]
  resources: ["pods","nodes","pods/log"]
  verbs: ["get","list","watch"]
---
kind: ClusterRoleBinding
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
metadata:
  name: redwood-runtime-binding
subjects:
- kind: ServiceAccount
  name: redwood-runtime
  namespace: redwood
roleRef:
  kind: ClusterRole
  name: redwood-runtime-role
  apiGroup: rbac.authorization.k8s.io
```

raj - sales: Perfect. FinBank also asked about rollback/fallback if GPU nodes are unhealthy. Can we do automatic routing to hosted model with data isolation concerns?

emily - infra: We support policy-based routing: in the private control plane you can set fallback to a hosted model variant with request redaction and no persistent logits caching on the hosted side. We'll document what metadata is sent.

maria - solutions: I'll add a short SLO playbook for failover and a sample network diagram to the one-pager. ETA EOD tomorrow.

nina - security: I'll review the one-pager once it's drafted and add KMS whitelist language and required audit fields.

raj - sales: Thanks everyone — I'll reply to FinBank with the plan and ask for the SSH window for validation. :thumbsup:
